claims.explanation: Mitoxantrone is a topoisomerase II poison whose cellular efficacy is primarily limited by drug efflux via ABCG2/BCRP, which actively pumps mitoxantrone out of cells. Selectively killed lines are therefore expected to have low ABCG2 expression and intact drug retention/apoptotic machinery, while resistant lines show high ABCG2 (or other efflux) expression and/or defects in p53-dependent apoptosis. The strong enrichment of TP53 mutations among both sensitive and resistant lines suggests p53 status alone is not the main determinant, but loss of p53-mediated CD95/Fas apoptotic signaling may contribute to protection in some lines.
